cards.headline: The song that anchors a three-colour album
cards.snippet: 《蓝色骨头》 appears on Cui Jian's 2005 album 《给你一点颜色》, which is built around three colour themes: red, yellow and blue. Blue seems to be the most important of the three. The Douban page calls this track the album's theme song. It says the opening is about a "writer", but that the song really reflects Cui Jian's own attitude toward society and life.
cards.context: Album released March 2005 by China Culture Audio-Video.

cards.headline: An album that mixes rock, pop, electronic and hip-hop
cards.snippet: Compared with Cui Jian's earlier albums, 《给你一点颜色》 (2005) is described as more varied, more independent and more unified. Its three colour themes are held together by one thread. Along the way it moves through pop, rock, electronic music and hip-hop, which widened what the album could be.
cards.context: Douban's description of the album that contains 《蓝色骨头》.

cards.headline: The solo dance that left viewers in tears
cards.snippet: 看到平頭哥全身扭曲的獨舞,看到他想要得到一個他愛的人的一個擁抱都卻得不到,那種滋味,心如刀絞,淚如雨下
cards.context: A viewer describes the contorted solo dance and the unreturned longing for an embrace. Gloss: heartbreak, tears pouring.

cards.headline: Only Cui Jian could pull this off
cards.snippet: 只有崔健能在21世紀用電影結合音樂批判在中國那曾經迷失的季節,可,沒經歷過上世紀70年代,很難感受到那份辛酸和無奈。
cards.context: Gloss: only Cui Jian could use film and music to critique a lost era; without living through the 1970s, it's hard to feel the bitterness.

cards.headline: Water dance and an English solo song
cards.snippet: 一段水中独舞和最后一曲英文独唱都是含泪看的。
cards.context: Gloss: watched the underwater solo dance and the closing English song through tears.

cards.headline: Came for Huang Xuan, left with a harsher verdict
cards.snippet: 看完整片,覺得其實迷失的不是季節,而是人性...
cards.context: Gloss: after the whole film, it's not the season that was lost, but humanity. A reply to the film's 'lost season' theme.

cards.headline: Cui Jian's directorial debut shares the song's name
cards.snippet: Blue Bone is a 2014 Chinese film directed by Cui Jian. It stars Yin Fang, Ni Hongjie, Mao Amin, Huang Xuan and Zhao Youliang.
cards.context: The film earned Cui Jian the Best New Director award at the 15th Chinese Film Media Awards.
